**Group:** Detritus  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A non-living detrital particle that images as a solid, dark, opaque blob, packed enough that little internal structure or translucency is visible. Outlines may be rounded or irregular Key features: opaque dark interior, solid appearance, no cellular structure or pellet form.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **aggregate** | Aggregates are loose, translucent flocs with visible gaps; the Dense class is for solid, opaque masses. |
| **fecal_pellet_long** | Fecal pellets have a characteristic ovoid or cylindrical, often membrane-bound form; Dense particles are defined by opacity, not shape. |
